literal: On day jiawu, he went to Nanjing.
idiomatic: On jiawu day he traveled to Nanjing.

literal: Envoys were dispatched to Jin to demand the Tuyuhun rebels.
idiomatic: He sent envoys to Jin demanding the surrender of the Tuyuhun rebels.

literal: On day yiwei, the Biegude came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On yiwei day the Biegude brought tribute.

literal: On the yimao new moon of the third month, Jin sent Qi Prefecture defense commissioner Song Huiye and Hanlin tea-and-wine commissioner Zhang Yan to inquire after his health.
idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the third month Jin sent Qi Prefecture defense commissioner Song Huiye and Hanlin tea-and-wine commissioner Zhang Yan to inquire after the Emperor's health.

literal: In the intercalary month, he halted at Yang Gate.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month he encamped at Yang Gate.

literal: On the jiayin new moon of the fourth month of summer, the Iron Li came to pay tribute; their goods were divided and bestowed on the ministers.
idiomatic: That summer, on the jiayin new moon of the fourth month, the Iron Li brought tribute, and their gifts were divided among the ministers.

literal: On day bingzi, Jin sent envoys presenting willow-shoot archery saddles and horses.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Jin sent envoys bearing saddles and horses for willow-shoot archery.

literal: On the fifth day of the fifth month, day wuzi, slaughter was forbidden.
idiomatic: On the Double Fifth, wuzi day, slaughter was forbidden.

literal: On the guichou new moon of the sixth month, Jin's Prince of Qi, Chonggui, sent envoys to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the sixth month Jin's Prince of Qi, Chonggui, sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On day dingsi, Tudu and Susa came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Tudu and Susa came with tribute.

literal: On day yichou, Jin's emperor Jingtang died; his son Chonggui succeeded.
idiomatic: On yichou day Jin's emperor Jingtang died, and his son Chonggui took the throne.

literal: On day wuchen, Jin sent envoys announcing mourning; court was suspended for seven days.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Jin sent envoys announcing the mourning; court levees were suspended for seven days.

literal: On day gengwu, envoys were dispatched to Jin to offer condolences and sacrifice.
idiomatic: On gengwu day envoys were sent to Jin to offer condolences and sacrifice.

literal: On day dingchou, hearing the Grand Empress Dowager was unwell, the Emperor hurried in to attend her; every medicine he personally tasted.
idiomatic: On dingchou day, hearing the Grand Empress Dowager was ill, the Emperor rushed in to wait on her and personally tasted every dose of medicine.

literal: He also reported at Emperor Taizu's temple, visited the Bodhisattva Hall, and fed fifty thousand monks.
idiomatic: He also reported at Emperor Taizu's temple, visited the Bodhisattva Hall, and fed fifty thousand monks.

literal: In the seventh month she recovered.
idiomatic: In the seventh month she recovered.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day gengyin, Jin sent Golden Wield Guard senior general Liang Yan and Four Quarters Bureau commissioner Zhu Chongjie to express thanks; the letter styled him grandson but not subject; Guest Reception commissioner Qiao Rong was sent to rebuke them.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on gengyin day, Jin sent Golden Wield Guard senior general Liang Yan and Four Quarters Bureau commissioner Zhu Chongjie to offer thanks; their letter styled the Emperor as grandson but not as subject, and Guest Reception commissioner Qiao Rong was dispatched to rebuke them.

literal: Jing Yanguang replied: "The former emperor was installed by your holy court; the present ruler was invested by our own state.
idiomatic: Jing Yanguang answered, "The former emperor was enthroned by your holy court; the present ruler was invested by our own state.

literal: As neighbor and as grandson is acceptable; submitting memorials calling oneself subject is not.
idiomatic: As neighbor and as grandson is acceptable; submitting memorials that call oneself subject is not."

literal: " Qiao Rong returned and reported in full; the Emperor first conceived the intention of a southern campaign.
idiomatic: Qiao Rong returned and reported everything; the Emperor first conceived the plan of a southern campaign.

literal: On day xinmao, the Zubu, Biegude, and Wugu came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the Zubu, Biegude, and Wugu all brought tribute.

literal: Generals Tadali, Pugu, and others led the surrendered general Xiade to court and presented their captures.
idiomatic: Generals Tadali, Pugu, and others led the surrendered general Xiade to court and presented what they had taken.

literal: On day dingwei, Jin sent envoys announcing mourning for their grand empress dowager.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Jin sent envoys announcing mourning for their grand empress dowager.

literal: On day xinyou in the eighth month, the Jurchen, Zubu, and Wugu each presented local products.
idiomatic: On xinyou day in the eighth month the Jurchen, Zubu, and Wugu each presented local products.

literal: On day jiazi, Jin recovered Xiang Prefecture.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Jin recovered Xiang Prefecture.

literal: On day wuchen, an edict ordered Hedong military governor Liu Zhiyuan to escort the rebel Wugu commander to court via Yanjing.
idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict ordered Hedong military governor Liu Zhiyuan to send the rebel Wugu commander to court by way of Yanjing.

literal: On day guiyou, Tiancheng Army military governor Xiao Baishi was dispatched to Jin to offer condolences and sacrifice.
idiomatic: On guiyou day Tiancheng Army military governor Xiao Baishi was sent to Jin to offer condolences and sacrifice.

literal: On day renchen in the ninth month, envoys were dispatched to congratulate the Jin emperor on his succession.
idiomatic: On renchen day in the ninth month envoys were dispatched to congratulate the Jin emperor on his succession.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day jisi, troops were levied from all circuits.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on jisi day, troops were levied from every circuit.

literal: General Migude was dispatched to campaign against the Tangut.
idiomatic: General Migude was dispatched to campaign against the Tangut.

literal: On day yiwei in the eleventh month, Wuding Army reported pines bearing dates.
idiomatic: On yiwei day in the eleventh month Wuding Army reported pines bearing dates.

literal: On day guihai in the twelfth month, Jin sent envoys to express thanks.
idiomatic: On guihai day in the twelfth month Jin sent envoys to express thanks.

literal: That winter, he halted at Chicheng.
idiomatic: That winter he encamped at Chicheng.

literal: In the sixth year, in the second month of spring, on day yimao, Jin sent envoys presenting the late emperor's personal effects.
idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the second spring month, on yimao day, Jin sent envoys presenting the late emperor's personal effects.

literal: On day xinyou, Jin sent envoys requesting to reside at Bian; the request was granted.
idiomatic: On xinyou day Jin sent envoys asking to move the court to Bian; the request was granted.

literal: On the jimao new moon of the third month, the King of Wuyue sent envoys to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the third month the King of Wuyue sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On day jiashen, Melichuanyin came to submit.
idiomatic: On jiashen day Melichuanyin came to submit.

literal: On day wuzi, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter.

literal: On day dingwei, Jin reached Bian; envoys were sent to express thanks.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Jin reached Bian, and envoys were sent to express thanks.

literal: On the wushen new moon of the fourth month of summer, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: That summer, on the wushen new moon of the fourth month, there was a solar eclipse.

literal: On day jihai in the fifth month, envoys were dispatched to Jin to present birthday gifts.
idiomatic: On jihai day in the fifth month envoys were sent to Jin with birthday gifts.

literal: On the dingwei new moon of the sixth month, the Iron Li came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon of the sixth month the Iron Li brought tribute.

literal: On day jiwei, the Xi Chuguli tribe presented white musk deer.
idiomatic: On jiwei day the Xi Chuguli tribe presented white musk deer.

literal: On day xinyou, Mo Prefecture presented a white magpie.
idiomatic: On xinyou day Mo Prefecture presented a white magpie.

literal: Jin sent envoys presenting gold.
idiomatic: Jin sent envoys presenting gold.

literal: On the dingwei new moon of the eighth month of autumn, Jin again presented gold.
idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month, on the dingwei new moon, Jin again presented gold.

literal: On day jiwei, he went to Fengsheng Prefecture.
idiomatic: On jiwei day he went to Fengsheng Prefecture.

literal: Jin sent his son Yanshu to court.
idiomatic: Jin sent his son Yanshu to court.

literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on day xinmao, Supreme Capital garrison commander Yelü Dielian captured a Jin spy and learned of duplicitous intentions.
idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, on xinmao day, Supreme Capital garrison commander Yelü Dielian captured a Jin spy and learned that Jin was of two minds.

literal: On day jiachen, the Iron Li came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On jiachen day the Iron Li brought tribute.

literal: On day dingwei in the twelfth month, he went to Nanjing to deliberate attacking Jin.
idiomatic: On dingwei day in the twelfth month he went to Nanjing to plan an attack on Jin.

literal: Zhao Yanzhou, Zhao Yanzhao, Anduan, Jieli, and others were ordered to advance by separate routes through Cang, Heng, Yi, and Ding; the main army followed.
idiomatic: Zhao Yanzhou, Zhao Yanzhao, Anduan, Jieli, and others were ordered to advance by separate routes through Cang, Heng, Yi, and Ding, with the main army following after.

literal: That year, Yang Yanzhao requested transfer to garrison Nailuo and the new garrison; the request was granted.
idiomatic: That year Yang Yanzhao asked to be transferred to garrison Nailuo and the new garrison, and the request was granted.

literal: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first month of spring, Zhao Yanzhou and Yanzhao led fifty thousand vanguard cavalry to camp at Renqiu.
idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first spring month, Zhao Yanzhou and Yanzhao led fifty thousand vanguard horsemen to camp at Renqiu.

literal: On day bingzi, Anduan entered Yanmen Pass and besieged Xin and Dai.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Anduan entered Yanmen Pass and besieged Xin and Dai.

literal: On day jimao, Zhao Yanzhou besieged Bei Prefecture; army officer Shao Ke opened the south gate to admit Liao troops; prefect Wu Luan threw himself into a well and died.
idiomatic: On jimao day Zhao Yanzhou besieged Bei Prefecture; army officer Shao Ke opened the south gate to admit Liao troops, and prefect Wu Luan threw himself into a well and died.

literal: On day jichou, he halted at Yuancheng, appointed Yanzhou military governor of Wei, Bo, and other prefectures, enfeoffed him as Prince of Wei, and had him lead his forces to camp at Nanle.
idiomatic: On jichou day he halted at Yuancheng, made Yanzhou military governor of Wei, Bo, and other prefectures, enfeoffed him as Prince of Wei, and had him lead his command to camp at Nanle.

literal: On day bingshen, troops were dispatched to attack Liyang; Jin's Zhang Yanzhe came to resist.
idiomatic: On bingshen day troops were sent to attack Liyang; Jin's Zhang Yanzhe came out to resist.

literal: On day xinchou, Jin sent envoys to restore the old amity; an edict ceded the Hebei prefectures and ordered Sang Weihan and Jing Yanguang to come for negotiations.
idiomatic: On xinchou day Jin sent envoys seeking to restore the old friendship; an edict ceded the Hebei prefectures and ordered Sang Weihan and Jing Yanguang to come and negotiate.

literal: On the jiachen new moon of the second month, Bozhou was attacked; prefect Zhou Ru surrendered the city.
idiomatic: On the jiachen new moon of the second month Bozhou was attacked, and prefect Zhou Ru surrendered the city.

literal: Jin's Pinglu Army military governor Yang Guangyuan secretly guided Liao forces across the river at Ma Family Pass.
idiomatic: Jin's Pinglu Army military governor Yang Guangyuan secretly guided Liao forces across the river at Ma Family Pass.

literal: Jin general Jing Yanguang ordered Shi Bin to hold Majia Pass and Bai Zairong to hold Ma Family Pass.
idiomatic: Jin general Jing Yanguang ordered Shi Bin to hold Majia Pass and Bai Zairong to hold Ma Family Pass.

literal: Before long, Zhou Ru guided Liao troops under Mada to camp east of the river and attack the north ford of Yan Prefecture, to coordinate with Guangyuan.
idiomatic: Before long Zhou Ru guided Liao troops under Mada to camp east of the river and attack the north ford of Yan Prefecture, to coordinate with Guangyuan.

literal: Jin dispatched Li Shouzhen, Huangfu Yu, Liang Hanzhang, and Xue Huairang leading ten thousand men, advancing by land and water along the river.
idiomatic: Jin dispatched Li Shouzhen, Huangfu Yu, Liang Hanzhang, and Xue Huairang with ten thousand men, advancing by land and water along the river.

literal: Liao troops besieged a Jin detached commander at Qicheng; the Jin emperor personally led troops to the rescue and the Liao army withdrew.
idiomatic: Liao troops besieged a Jin detached commander at Qicheng; the Jin emperor personally led troops to the rescue, and the Liao army withdrew.

literal: Shouzhen and the others reached Ma Family Pass; Mada sent ten thousand foot soldiers to build ramparts, ten thousand cavalry to guard outside, and the rest encamped west of the river.
idiomatic: Shouzhen and the others reached Ma Family Pass; Mada sent ten thousand foot soldiers to build ramparts, ten thousand cavalry to guard outside, and stationed the rest west of the river.

literal: Before the crossing was complete, Jin troops pressed them and the Liao army fared badly.
idiomatic: Before the crossing was finished Jin troops pressed them hard, and the Liao army fared badly.

literal: On the guiyou new moon of the third month, Zhao Yanzhou said: "Jin's armies have set palisades along the river, all too fearful to fight.
idiomatic: On the guiyou new moon of the third month Zhao Yanzhou said, "Jin's armies have set palisades along the river and are all too fearful to fight.

literal: If we lead the main force straight to Chanyuan and seize its bridges, Jin can surely be taken.
idiomatic: If we lead the main force straight to Chanyuan and seize its bridges, Jin can surely be taken."

literal: " That day Jin troops were encamped at Chanyuan; their vanguard Gao Xingzhou was at Qicheng.
idiomatic: That day Jin troops were encamped at Chanyuan, with their vanguard Gao Xingzhou at Qicheng.

literal: Zhao Yanzhou and Yanzhao were then ordered with tens of thousands of cavalry to outflank Xingzhou on the right; the Emperor with elite troops on the left.
idiomatic: Zhao Yanzhou and Yanzhao were then ordered to take tens of thousands of horsemen around Xingzhou's right, while the Emperor with picked troops struck on the left.

literal: Fighting until dusk, the Emperor again sent strong cavalry to charge their center; the Jin army could not hold.
idiomatic: They fought until dusk; the Emperor again sent strong cavalry to charge the Jin center, and the Jin army could not stand.

literal: A spy reported Jin's eastern numbers were few and the riverine palisades insecure; they pressed the eastern flank hard and the masses broke and fled.
idiomatic: A spy reported that Jin's eastern numbers were few and the riverine palisades weak; they pressed the eastern flank hard, and the masses broke and fled.

literal: Cavalry was loosed in pursuit and they were utterly routed.
idiomatic: Cavalry was loosed in pursuit, and Jin was utterly routed.

literal: On day renwu, Zhao Yanzhao was left to hold Bei Prefecture; captured households were relocated to the interior.
idiomatic: On renwu day Zhao Yanzhao was left to hold Bei Prefecture, and captured households were moved into the interior.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day guichou, he returned and halted at Nanjing.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on guichou day, he returned and halted at Nanjing.

literal: On day xinwei, he went to Liang Pass.
idiomatic: On xinwei day he went to Liang Pass.

literal: On day guiyou in the fifth month, Yelü Balide reported capturing Dezhou, taking prefect Yin Juhan and twenty-seven officers and officials prisoner.
idiomatic: On guiyou day in the fifth month Yelü Balide reported that Dezhou had been taken and prefect Yin Juhan and twenty-seven officers and officials captured.

literal: On day jiachen in the sixth month, the Black Cart Shiwei came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On jiachen day in the sixth month the Black Cart Shiwei brought tribute.

literal: On day yisi, Renmeili, Yaoli, and other states came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On yisi day Renmeili, Yaoli, and other states came with tribute.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day jimao, Jin's Yang Guangyuan sent men bearing a wax-sealed letter.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on jimao day, Jin's Yang Guangyuan sent men bearing a wax-sealed letter.

literal: On day xinmao, Jin sent Zhang Hui with a memorial begging peace; Hui was detained and not sent back.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Jin sent Zhang Hui with a memorial begging peace; Hui was detained and not sent back.

literal: On day xinyou in the eighth month, the Uighur sent envoys requesting marriage; it was not granted.
idiomatic: On xinyou day in the eighth month the Uighur sent envoys requesting marriage; the request was denied.

literal: That month, Jin troops from Zhen Prefecture came to raid Feihu; Datong Army military governor Yelü Kong'a defeated them.
idiomatic: That month Jin troops from Zhen Prefecture raided Feihu; Datong Army military governor Yelü Kong'a defeated them.

literal: On the gengwu new moon of the ninth month, he proceeded north on tour.
idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the ninth month he proceeded north on tour.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day dingwei, the Biegude came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on dingwei day, the Biegude brought tribute.

literal: On day renxu, on the Tianshou festival, the various states came to offer congratulations; only Jin did not come.
idiomatic: On renxu day, at the Tianshou festival, the various states came to offer congratulations; only Jin did not come.

literal: On day renshen in the eleventh month, an edict levied troops from all circuits to assemble north of the Wenyu River on the intercalary month's new moon.
idiomatic: On renshen day in the eleventh month an edict levied troops from every circuit to assemble north of the Wenyu River on the intercalary month's new moon.

literal: On day guimao in the twelfth month, a southern campaign was launched.
idiomatic: On guimao day in the twelfth month the southern campaign was launched.

literal: On day jiazi, he halted at Gubei Pass.
idiomatic: On jiazi day he halted at Gubei Pass.

literal: On the jisi new moon of the intercalary month, troops from all circuits were reviewed at the Wenyu River.
idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the intercalary month troops from every circuit were reviewed at the Wenyu River.

literal: On day jimao, Heng Prefecture was besieged and its nine counties were taken.
idiomatic: On jimao day Heng Prefecture was besieged and its nine counties were taken.

literal: In the eighth year, on day gengzi in the first month of spring, forces were divided to attack Xing, Ming, and Ci prefectures; killing and looting were nearly complete.
idiomatic: In the eighth year, on gengzi day in the first spring month, forces were divided to attack Xing, Ming, and Ci prefectures, killing and looting almost without limit.

literal: They entered the territory of Yedu.
idiomatic: They entered the territory of Yedu.

literal: Zhang Cong'en, Ma Quanjie, and An Shenqi drew up all their forces south of the Anyang River at Xiang Prefecture.
idiomatic: Zhang Cong'en, Ma Quanjie, and An Shenqi drew up all their forces south of the Anyang River at Xiang Prefecture.

literal: Huangfu Yu and Puzhou prefect Murong Yanchao led a thousand horsemen to scout the Liao army.
idiomatic: Huangfu Yu and Puzhou prefect Murong Yanchao led a thousand horsemen to scout the Liao army.

literal: Reaching Yedu, they met tens of thousands of Liao troops; fighting as they retreated, they reached Yulin Inn.
idiomatic: Reaching Yedu they met tens of thousands of Liao troops; fighting as they fell back, they reached Yulin Inn.

literal: Liao troops pressed after them; Yu and Yanchao fought strenuously for more than a hundred rounds; Yu's horse was killed and he fought on foot; Shenqi led cavalry across the water to the rescue and the Liao army withdrew.
idiomatic: Liao troops pressed after them; Yu and Yanchao fought strenuously for more than a hundred rounds; Yu's horse was killed and he fought on foot; Shenqi led cavalry across the river to the rescue, and the Liao army withdrew.

literal: In the second month, Wei was besieged; Jin general Du Chongwei led troops to the rescue.
idiomatic: In the second month Wei was besieged; Jin general Du Chongwei led troops to the rescue.

literal: On day wuzi, Jin general Zhe Congruan captured Sheng Prefecture.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Jin general Zhe Congruan captured Sheng Prefecture.
